findings.desc: Packaged desktop binary fails a real Koala CLI command: `dist/desktop/koala-macos-arm64 verify_codex` exits 1 because `packages/main/src/core/codex-adapter-checks.ts:235` runs the local Codex heartbeat through `process.execPath`; inside the pkg executable that is the packaged binary, not Node, so it tries to load `bin/koala-codex.js` through the pkg CommonJS loader and throws ERR_REQUIRE_ESM. This means the single-file CLI can pass the narrow help smoke but still ships with broken self-diagnostics/Codex verification behavior. Packaging entrypoint/runtime staging is introduced in `scripts/package-desktop.mjs:60` and needs either a packaged-mode handling path or smoke coverage for this command class before release.
